zh: 桌面智能体可视化预览沙箱与额度趋势抖动平滑：桌面会话 Widget 预览安全开放脚本与图表渲染支持；额度消耗时间曲线对重置时间戳增加分钟级舍入与时间容差，防止服务商秒级抖动导致曲线虚假折断。
AI 指针群协同绘制节奏平抑与骨架线框纯粹化：引入自适应平滑推进机制，在 AI 极速输出时平抑展开速度，留出 4~8 秒优雅呈现周期；彻底移除作品中不存在的虚构波动曲线图表，全面聚焦真实页面组件的骨架线框测绘、四角锚点控制柄与尺寸对齐标尺，指针运动更加稳健沉着。
桌面底栏与宠物窗口额度趋势图交互精简：优化额度消耗时间曲线样式，移除交互探测点的悬停灰点与连续折线末端冗余圆点，仅对孤立单点保留打点，提升曲线干净度与观感。
内置浏览器远程下载管理：支持在远程/网页端内置浏览器中捕获、查看并一键保存已完成的文件下载，下载按钮提供实时状态徽标提醒。
智能体工具权限收敛与状态联动：WeLink 频道消息（机器人推送）纳入团队默认关闭策略，与平台共享 MCP 保持一致；当底层频道未启用时自动对非超管隐藏，超管后台清晰标明连接状态。
en: Desktop agent visual preview sandbox & quota jitter smoothing: safely enabled script and chart rendering inside desktop agent widget previews; smoothed quota history reset timestamps with minute-rounding and tolerance against transient provider ticks.

AI Cursor Swarm Live Painter pacing & wireframe focus: introduced an adaptive smoothing pipeline that paces rapid stream bursts across a 4-8 second build cycle; completely removed fictional sine-wave curves in favor of authentic CAD/Figma-style component wireframe outlines, corner handles, and dimension guides.

Desktop quota bar & pet trend chart visual refinement: streamlined quota consumption curves by removing hover-point fills and redundant segment endpoints, marking only isolated points for a cleaner look.
Built-in browser remote download management: captures completed file downloads in the remote browser view with status indicators and one-click local saving.

Agent tool access hardening & channel status linking: WeLink channel messaging (bot push) is now off for teams by default alongside shared MCP; tools are hidden from non-super admins when the channel is disabled.
